abstract_sentences.text: Personalized alignment of large language models seeks to adapt responses to individual user preferences, typically via reinforcement learning.

evidence.anchor: adapt responses to individual user preferences

abstract_sentences.text: A key challenge is obtaining accurate, user-specific reward signals in open-ended scenarios.

Existing personalized reward models face two persistent limitations: (1) oversimplifying diverse, scenario-specific preferences into a small, fixed set of evaluation principles, and (2) struggling with generalization to new users with limited feedback.
To this end, we propose P-GenRM, the first Personalized Generative Reward Model with test-time user-based scaling.

evidence.anchor: the first Personalized Generative Reward Model

abstract_sentences.text: P-GenRM transforms preference signals into structured evaluation chains that derive adaptive personas and scoring rubrics across various scenarios.

It further clusters users into User Prototypes and introduces a dual-granularity scaling mechanism: at the individual level, it adaptively scales and aggregates each user’s scoring scheme; at the prototype level, it incorporates preferences from similar users.
This design mitigates noise in inferred preferences and enhances generalization to unseen users through prototype-based transfer.

Empirical results show that P-GenRM achieves state-of-the-art results on widely-used personalized reward model benchmarks, with an average improvement of 2.31%, and demonstrates strong generalization on an out-of-distribution dataset.
Notably, Test-time User-based scaling provides an additional 3% boost, demonstrating stronger personalized alignment with test-time scalability.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把稀疏、嘈杂且随场景变化的用户偏好转成带 persona 与 weighted rubric 的生成式 evaluation chain，再用 individual sampling 和 prototype transfer 在 test time 聚合评分。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题定义、三阶段训练、reward、prototype refinement 公式骨架、dual-granularity scaling、主 benchmark、组件消融、prototype 选择、OOD 表和结论。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载 prompt、macro accuracy、α–β、历史样本数、prototype 数、latency、policy DPO/GRPO、数据集和基线细节；迁移保持正文短，但 OOD 代理 ground truth、成本分解和下游统计需回看附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 先将 hybrid signals、persona、rubric 和双粒度 aggregation 串成路径，Figure 2 再对齐训练阶段，Table 4 最后以统一预算展示 Ind/Pro 的互补与负结果。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 没有 formal guarantee；降噪和 prototype transfer 主要由 accuracy、合成 OOD ranking 与定性图示间接支撑，训练测试隔离和完整计算预算也未报告。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 生成式 reward 方法若同时主张解释链与 test-time aggregation，应在同一因果顺序中给出对象、生成链、聚合算子、主结果和至少一个机制消融。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于以生成链和推理时计算换取个性化评分的 reward/judge 方法；formal guarantee、在线用户实验或安全部署论文需把证明、干预设计或故障边界放入正文。
